How connections work

## Connect. Process. Sync. Audit.The agent handles it and leaves a trail.

01

Connect

Authenticate once. Nanonets reads from your inboxes, cloud storage, and file drops — no per-format configuration required.

02

Process

Agents extract, validate, and apply your business rules. Any document format, any vendor layout, no templates.

03

Sync

Clean, validated data is written back to your systems of record in real time. Two-way sync keeps everything consistent.

04

Audit

Every action is logged with full provenance. Compliance teams get the trail. Finance teams get reconciled records.

Why native, not middleware

## Most automation tools add a layer.Nanonets lives inside the one you already have.

No rip-and-replace

Your agents live inside the stack you already own. No migration, no replatforming. SAP stays SAP. NetSuite stays NetSuite.

Real-time, two-way sync

Changes in your ERP reflect back in the agent's context. The agent writes to your system only after every validation passes.

Pre-built and custom connectors

25+ native connectors for the most common stacks, plus REST and webhook support for any system we haven't wired up yet.

Enterprise auth standards

OAuth 2.0, SAML, and API key flows supported. SSO and role-based access control for every connected system.

25+

native connectors shipping today

Don’t see your system on the list? We’ll wire it up.

Our integrations team has built custom connectors for legacy ERPs, in-house platforms, and niche industry tools. Tell us what you’re running and we’ll scope it in the first call.

[Talk to an engineer](https://nanonets.com/integrations#)
